summary.name: MenuScores
summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app that shows live sports scores, stats, and news for favorite teams across many leagues.
use_cases: Follow live game scores from the Mac menu bar
Track favorite teams without searching for games
See real-time stats and updates for multiple sports
Keep sports news visible from the notch area
summary.what_it_does: MenuScores is a Mac app that displays live sports scores, stats, and updates from the menu bar or the notch. You choose favorite teams and the app pins them for you. It says it tracks over 60 leagues across 13 sports. It also shows relevant pre-game details. The page lists installation via Homebrew and a Mac download. The Awesome Mac listing describes it as a menu bar app for real-time sports news and scores, and marks it as open source with a GitHub link.
